Container.Name: yt-dlp-ng
Container.Overview: A self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp. Queue downloads, watch live progress and logs, manage quality presets and cookies, and bulk-import links from pasted text or a bookmarks HTML file -- all from your browser. Files are saved directly to a folder on your array.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Folder where downloaded files are saved. The UI can create/browse subfolders inside this path but can never escape it.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Persistent app data: job database, per-job logs, download archive, and optional cookies.txt

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns downloaded files. 99 = Unraid's built-in 'nobody'.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns downloaded files. 100 = Unraid's built-in 'users'.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Umask applied to newly created files/folders

Config.Name: Max Concurrent Downloads
Config.Description: Number of downloads that may run at the same time

Config.Name: Update yt-dlp on Start
Config.Description: If true, runs 'pip install -U yt-dlp' every time the container starts

Config.Name: Resume on Start
Config.Description: If true, automatically requeues jobs that were still queued/running when the container last stopped

Config.Name: Imaglr Max Pages
Config.Description: Safety cap on the number of pages enumerated per imaglr.com profile/page/tag/RSS listing

Config.Name: Proxy Test URL
Config.Description: Default health-check URL used to decide whether a configured proxy (Settings -> Proxies) is live
